column1: # MODE: PROD
# Which artifacts belong to which integration mode.
# A skill that offers more than one way to be driven declares it here, and
# `install.sh --integration <skill>=<mode>` picks one without a prompt, so an
# agent can choose its own interface headlessly.
# The rule is deliberately narrow: a binary named below installs ONLY in its
# mode, and every file not named installs in every mode. So SKILL.md and the
# binaries registry are never mode-dependent.
# `skill` is the default: tailpipe-client-rs is the reader AND the ingest
# path (piping stdin into a stream is inherently a shell operation, not
# something an MCP tool call can do), so it ships regardless of mode. `mcp`
# additionally installs tailpipe-mcp -- the consumer an agent calls as typed
# tools instead of shelling out for every read/search/wait/save.
# tailpipe-server-rs is deliberately UNLISTED, not skill-only. Somebody has
# to run the server, and in mcp mode that somebody is the same agent: the
# adapter finds a server (via TAILPIPE_ENDPOINT or its own default path) and
# does not start one.
mode
skill
column3: Reader and ingest path the skill's own instructions drive
